_doc: Single source of truth for the village look. Every leaf is {v, why}. Read by scripts/look.gd; documented in docs/art-pipeline.md. Change values here, never in scene code.

far_fov.why: vertical degrees; near-orthographic like a pre-rendered iso game

near_fov.why: mid view becomes a natural perspective around the character

far_width.why: metres of ground across the screen; closer than 22 m so building and material detail reads

near_width.why: mid view frames the character plus their surroundings

far_pitch.why: steep ARPG look-down; walls still visible

near_pitch.why: flatter at mid range so faces of buildings fill more of the frame

tonemap_exposure.why: AgX exposure; lit ground lands near the 0.45 target

tonemap_white.why: AgX white point; keeps sunlit plaster from clipping

adjustment_contrast.why: neutral: extra contrast crushed shadows to black (art review 2)

ambient_sky_contribution.why: half the fill comes from a neutral grey instead of the blue HDRI sky, so shadows are not blue

sdfgi_energy.why: bounce light; higher washed out the key/fill ratio

ssao_radius.why: metres; tight contact occlusion at bases, crevices come from baked AO

ssao_power.why: sharpens the falloff so it reads as contact, not haze

ssil_radius.why: metres of screen-space bounce (walls onto ground)

angular_distance.why: degrees; the real sun: crisp contact, softening with distance

peak_elevation.why: noon elevation; long enough shadows to model form

yaw_at_noon.why: degrees; light from the upper left of the screen (classic iso key)

yaw_per_hour.why: sun moves across the sky during the day

shadow_normal_bias.why: no acne on gently curved thatch

shadow_margin.why: metres added to the fitted shadow range beyond the farthest visible ground

triplanar_tiles.why: tiles per metre for world-triplanar placeholder geometry

triplanar_tint.why: leafy_grass reads as dry dirt from above; push it to green

weathered._why: per material slot of scripted assets (tools/blender), parameters of shaders/weathered.gdshader

stone.why: moss on stone footings and chimneys

plaster.why: splash dirt up to ~1 m on daub

timber.why: the Poly Haven planks are very dark; lifted so lit planks reach ~0.18+

thatch.why: grey scan aged to straw; second sample hides the tile period

cloth.why: faded madder linen on the plaster grain

weathered_common.why: shared by every slot; splash/grime lowered in art review 2 (they crushed timber to 0.09)

water.why: depth-coloured river over a visible bed

ground.why: darkens bright scans so lit ground sits near 0.45

flat.why: untextured slots and placeholders (player capsule, torch post, window voids)

skirt.why: dirt skirt decal under every placed building/prop (rule, applied automatically)

grass_points.why: candidate tuft positions; noise clustering keeps about half

grass_keep.why: base keep probability before noise clustering

grass_tuft.why: short pale tufts read as texture at the far view

debris_points.why: about one small detail per square metre near paths and houses

tree_clearance.why: metres; crowns never hang over the river, houses or paths

keep_off_paths.why: props that must never block a path or yard; dropped if placed on trampled ground (mask > 0.3)

checks._why: tools/art_check.py: measured on the captured shots (1920x1080, greyscale means of regions). Fails the run if out of range.

shadow_ground.why: ground in the barn's shadow: ~4:1 against lit

budgets.why: max triangles per GLB on an M2 Pro
